Experiential

Mighty Adventures Experience

The UK has more than its fair share of dinosaur-themed crazy golf. But more often than not, the only crazy thing about it, is the prices. We created an experience for Mighty Adventures that truly lives up to its name.

The work

Invention

Read. Play. Learn.

Through a powerful combination of entertainment and education, we turned Mighty Adventures into an invaluable experience for kids and parents.

We introduced the strategy, ‘Read. Play. Learn’. Engaging with relatable content and beautiful design; entertaining through experiences that stimulate physical senses and fully immerse players in our world; educating with fun factoids, educational games, interactive play areas and positive social messages.
